_captured: Hand-authored from the SHAPE of real list-user-decks and deck/list-vocabulary responses, probed 2026-08-07 with the repo owner's JPDB_API_KEY (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN M2.5). The deck names are invented: the real ones name the owner's account contents, which do not belong in a public repo. Field order and value types are the API's.
_notes: list-user-decks rows are [id, name, word_count] under the requested fields. The real account's first deck reported word_count 544 while deck/list-vocabulary returned 584 pairs, so word_count is NOT the pair count — nothing may assert they agree.

deck/list-vocabulary rows are [vid, sid] pairs. With fetch_occurences the counts ride in a top-level "occurences" list [sic] parallel to the words; janki does not store them (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN M2.5 defers them deliberately).
Deck names here deliberately include a colon, a comma and a period: Anki splits tags on whitespace and nests them on '::', so deck_tag has to flatten all of it.
